title: Rails Action Cable Configuration
markdownDescription:
Configures Action Cable subscription adapters for WebSocket connections in Rails applications. Each top-level key represents an environment (development, test, production, etc.) that specifies how Action Cable handles real-time pub/sub messaging.

See the [Rails Guide](https://guides.rubyonrails.org/action_cable_overview.html#configuration) for more information.

environment.title: Environment
environment.markdownDescription: Action Cable environment configuration. Specifies the adapter and connection details for pub/sub messaging.

redis.markdownDescription:
Redis adapter for Action Cable. Requires a Redis server for pub/sub messaging across multiple server instances. Supports SSL/TLS connections.

All options other than `adapter` and `channel_prefix` are passed directly to `Redis.new`, so any [redis-rb client option](https://github.com/redis/redis-rb#getting-started) (e.g. `host`, `port`, `db`, `password`, `driver`, `sentinels`) may be used.

adapter.markdownDescription: Adapter type for Redis-backed pub/sub messaging.

url.markdownDescription:
Connection URL for the Redis server. Use `redis://` for standard connections or `rediss://` for SSL/TLS connections.

Examples:
- `redis://localhost:6379`
- `rediss://10.10.3.153:6380` (SSL/TLS)

channel_prefix.markdownDescription:
Optional prefix for channel names to avoid collisions when multiple applications share the same Redis server.

Example: `appname_production` results in channels like `appname_production:chat_room_1`

id.markdownDescription:
Identifier used as the Redis client name for Action Cable connections.

Default: `ActionCable-PID-<pid>`

reconnect_attempts.markdownDescription:
Number of reconnection attempts for the subscription connection, or an array of delays (in seconds) to wait between each attempt. Also passed to the Redis client.

Default: `1`

ssl_params.markdownDescription:
SSL/TLS parameters for secure Redis connections. Parameters are passed directly to [`OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext#set_params`](https://docs.ruby-lang.org/en/master/OpenSSL/SSL/SSLContext.html#method-i-set_params).

Common parameters include `ca_file`, `cert`, `key`, and `verify_mode`. Use `verify_mode: <%= OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE %>` to skip certificate verification (not recommended for production).

postgresql.markdownDescription:
PostgreSQL adapter for Action Cable. Uses PostgreSQL's `LISTEN`/`NOTIFY` for pub/sub messaging over the Active Record connection pool, so it requires the application's primary database to be PostgreSQL.

Note that `NOTIFY` payloads are limited to 8000 bytes.

adapter.markdownDescription: Adapter type for PostgreSQL `LISTEN`/`NOTIFY` pub/sub messaging.

channel_prefix.markdownDescription:
Optional prefix for channel names to avoid collisions when multiple applications share the same database.

Example: `appname_production` results in channels like `appname_production:chat_room_1`

id.markdownDescription:
Identifier used as the PostgreSQL `application_name` for the Action Cable listener connection.

Default: `ActionCable-PID-<pid>`

async.markdownDescription:
Async adapter for Action Cable. Intended for development and testing only. Runs pub/sub messaging within the same process, so it only works with a single server instance.

**Not suitable for production use.**

adapter.markdownDescription: Adapter type for in-process async pub/sub messaging. Development and testing only.

test.markdownDescription: Test adapter for Action Cable. Used during automated testing to capture and assert on Action Cable broadcasts without requiring an external service.

adapter.markdownDescription: Adapter type for test environment. Captures broadcasts for testing assertions.

solid_cable.markdownDescription:
Solid Cable adapter for Action Cable. A database-backed solution using Active Record for pub/sub messaging. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.

Run `bin/rails solid_cable:install` to set up. See [Solid Cable](https://github.com/rails/solid_cable) for more information.

adapter.markdownDescription: Adapter type for database-backed pub/sub messaging using Solid Cable.

connects_to.markdownDescription: Database connection configuration for Solid Cable. Specifies which database to use for storing messages. Accepts the same options as Active Record's `connects_to`.

polling_interval.markdownDescription:
How frequently to poll the database for new messages. Accepts a duration in `<amount>.<unit>` format (e.g. `0.1.seconds`).

Default: `0.1.seconds`

message_retention.markdownDescription:
How long to retain messages in the database before they're eligible for deletion. Accepts a duration in `<amount>.<unit>` format (e.g. `1.day`).

Default: `1.day`

autotrim.markdownDescription:
Automatically trim old messages from the database based on `message_retention` setting.

Default: `true`

silence_polling.markdownDescription:
Suppress logging of database polling queries to reduce log noise.

Default: `true`

use_skip_locked.markdownDescription:
Use `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` when trimming messages. Set to `false` if your database doesn't support it (MySQL < 8.0, PostgreSQL < 9.5). Has no effect on SQLite.

Default: `true`

trim_batch_size.markdownDescription:
Number of old messages to delete in a single batch during autotrim.

Default: `100`

reconnect_attempts.markdownDescription:
Number of reconnection attempts when the listener's database connection fails, or an array of delays (in seconds) to wait between each attempt.

Default: `1`

writer_batch_size.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of broadcasts written to the database in a single batch insert.

Default: `4`

writer_batch_delay.markdownDescription:
How long the broadcaster waits to collect messages into a batch before writing them. Accepts a duration in `<amount>.<unit>` format (e.g. `0.001.seconds`).

Default: `0.001.seconds`

encrypt.markdownDescription:
Encrypt stored message payloads with [Active Record Encryption](https://guides.rubyonrails.org/active_record_encryption.html#setup). Requires the `msgpack` gem.

Default: `false`
